question: Should OpenClaw core add native cross-Gateway session messaging, and if so what peer identity, auth scopes, idempotency/replay, delivery, and transcript-ownership contract should it use?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses Gateway, session-state, message-delivery, config, and credential boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API or security model.

options.title: Design the contract first
options.body: Use this issue as the concrete session-tool tracker while aligning peer identity, scopes, replay/idempotency, transcript ownership, and federation protocol details before accepting code.

options.title: Advance a fresh narrow implementation
options.body: Invite a new implementation only after the stale PR's proof and allowlist problems are resolved in a design-approved shape.

options.title: Defer native core support
options.body: Document plugin, MCP, channel, or operator-run workarounds if maintainers intentionally decide not to add core cross-Gateway session routing now.

recommendation.title: Design the contract first
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the concrete session-tool tracker while aligning peer identity, scopes, replay/idempotency, transcript ownership, and federation protocol details before accepting code.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest routing owner from the maintainer comment plus session-spawn and Gateway role-policy history.
